name: AutoBot
description: Plays levels for you: finds a route by trial and error, then passes the level

auto-start.name: Start on every level
auto-start.description: When on, the bot takes over in every level you enter. When off, use the Bot button on the level page or in the pause menu.

learn-speed.name: Learning speed
learn-speed.description: How fast the hidden learning runs (the game is sped up behind the learning screen). The real run is always at 1x.

use-practice.name: Search in practice mode
use-practice.description: Search with practice checkpoints: much faster, but uses practice mode. When off, every try starts from the beginning in normal mode.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Bot runs do not save progress, stars or leaderboard results.

lookback.name: Lookback (ticks)
lookback.description: How far before a death (in 1/240 s ticks) the bot tries new inputs.

stride.name: Timing step (ticks)
stride.description: Step between tried input timings. 1 is the most precise and the slowest.

show-status.name: Show status
show-status.description: Shows the bot status in the top-left corner of the level.
